title: Zapata Quantum, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Zapata Quantum, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 24, 2026, reporting the completion of a private placement of Series D Convertible Preferred Stock and Warrants to accredited investors on April 22-23, 2026, yielding gross proceeds of $4,565,000 and completing the maximum offering amount of $15,000,000.
key_points: The company sold 4,565 shares of Series D Convertible Preferred Stock and Warrants to purchase 5,198,133 shares of common stock.
Gross proceeds from the April 22-23 sales totaled $4,565,000.
The total offering capacity was up to $15,000,000 (15,000 shares of Series D convertible into 34,160,784 shares; warrants for up to 17,080,392 shares).
The April 23 closing completed the maximum offering, and the offering has terminated.
Placement agents Craig-Hallum Capital Group and Odeon Capital Group received 2% warrant coverage and 6% cash fees.
The offering was exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b) of the Securities Act.
